function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content:
CPU usage refers to the amount of processing power that a computer’s central processing unit (CPU) is currently utilizing. It’s typically expressed as a percentage of the total available capacity. High CPU usage can indicate that a program or process is demanding a lot of computational resources, while low usage suggests idle or underutilized CPU time.

If you’d like to see the current CPU usage on your machine, let me know which operating system you’re using (Windows, macOS, Linux, etc.) and I can guide you through checking it—or even fetch the current value for you.
